game.title: AoD Defense
tip.wave1: Walk Ash with A/D or hold the left/right side of the screen. He shoots by himself.
tip.archer: Archers unlocked: they stay behind the front line and can hit flying enemies.
spell.super_boomstick.desc: A blast down the lane where Ash faces. Knocks enemies back.
spell.arrow_volley.desc: Rain of arrows over an area. Hits flyers. Burns at level 3.
spell.magic_words.desc: Random: heal everyone, call 3 soldiers, or stun every enemy.
spell.catapult_volley.desc: Three boulders crash down on an area.
spell.wrong_book.desc: Opens a hell portal: wounded enemies are dragged in, the rest are slowed.
spell.chainsaw.desc: Ash revs up: much stronger, faster melee with lifesteal.
spell.deathcoaster.desc: A steam car tears across the whole field.
title.subtitle: Hold back the Deadites. Keep them off the Necronomicon.
title.new_confirm: All progress, gold and upgrades will be erased (settings are kept). This cannot be undone.
save.recovered.backup: The save was damaged, so the backup was loaded.
save.recovered.defaults: The save could not be read, so a fresh save was started.
map.title: Wave Map
prewave.no_preview: No enemy preview for this wave yet.
pause.restart_confirm: Restart this wave from the beginning? Gold collected this wave is lost.
pause.quit_confirm: Quit to the map? This wave will not be saved.
shop.title: Upgrade Shop
shop.tree.pick: Pick a path (you can switch later)
settings.save_hint: Export a .json file to move your save to another device.
settings.reset_confirm1: Delete all progress, including gold, upgrades and settings?
settings.reset_confirm2: This cannot be undone. Export your save first if you want to keep it.
spell.salt_circle.desc: A ring of salt. Undead inside move at half speed and take damage over time.
spell.salt_circle.t1: Learn Salt Circle: radius 140 for 6 s; enemies inside are slowed 50% and take 8 damage/s
spell.salt_circle.t2: Radius grows to 180 and the circle lasts 8 s
spell.salt_circle.t3a: Binding: enemies are rooted for 1.5 s the first time they step in (shorter on bosses)
spell.salt_circle.t3b: Cleansing: our side heals 6 HP/s while standing inside
spell.matins_bell.desc: Stuns every enemy on screen. Bosses are stunned for less.
spell.matins_bell.t1: Learn Matins Bell: stuns every enemy for 1.5 s (bosses 0.5 s)
spell.matins_bell.t2: Stun lasts 2 s and breaks off a boss attack that is winding up
spell.matins_bell.t3a: Shatter: stunned enemies take 30% more damage
spell.matins_bell.t3b: Quick peal: cooldown drops from 35 s to 22 s
spell.hellfire_pitch.desc: Boiling pitch poured from the wall sets the ground before the castle on fire.
spell.hellfire_pitch.t1: Learn Hellfire Pitch: the ground before the wall burns for 5 s, 12 damage/s
spell.hellfire_pitch.t2: The fire spreads further: the burning strip grows from 300 to 440
spell.hellfire_pitch.t3a: Tar: enemies in the fire are slowed 40%
spell.hellfire_pitch.t3b: Blast: enemies that die in the fire explode for 20 damage (radius 80)
spell.bear_traps.desc: Sets traps around a point. Enemies that step in take damage and are held in place.
spell.bear_traps.t1: Learn Iron Jaw Traps: 3 traps, each deals 35 damage and holds the victim for 2 s
spell.bear_traps.t3a: Serrated: victims bleed for 6 damage/s over 5 s
spell.bear_traps.t3b: Chained: a sprung trap drags in enemies within 80
spell.dawn_lance.desc: Ash hurls a lance of light that pierces the whole lane.
spell.dawn_lance.t1: Learn Dawn Lance: a lance of light pierces the whole lane for 70 damage
spell.dawn_lance.t2: Damage rises to 100 and the lance knocks enemies back
spell.dawn_lance.t3a: Silver mark: enemies hit take 25% more damage for 5 s
spell.dawn_lance.t3b: Twin lances: throws two lances in a row
spell.rally_horn.desc: All your troops hit harder and faster for a while.
spell.rally_horn.t1: Learn Rally Horn: the army deals 25% more damage and moves 20% faster for 8 s
spell.rally_horn.t3a: Muster: 4 peasants run out to help every time it sounds
spell.rally_horn.t3b: Bloodthirst: the army heals for 15% of the damage it deals
relic.gravedigger_lantern.desc: Gold pickup range +60%. Coins stay 5 s longer.
relic.hollow_spur.desc: Cavalry and hero charge damage +40%. Dodge cooldown −30%.
relic.censer_of_matins.desc: The book regains 2 HP/s. Undead near the castle take 5/s.
relic.doppel_boomstick.desc: Ash's shotgun fires twice. Unlocks the Evil Ash hero.
lobby.title: Online co-op
lobby.intro: Play with a friend: you are Ash, your friend commands the army.
lobby.host_sub: You play Ash and get a code to share
lobby.join_sub: Enter their code and command the army
lobby.waiting_guest: Waiting for your friend to join...
lobby.waiting_host: Waiting for the host to start a battle...
lobby.guest_role: You command the army: summon troops, cast spells, upgrade the smith, rally. A/D pans the view.
lobby.err_no_room: No room with that code. Check it and try again.
lobby.err_network: Could not reach the online service. Check the internet connection.
lobby.err_browser: This browser cannot play online (WebRTC is missing).
title.install_ios: iPhone/iPad: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen"
title.install_other: Open the browser menu and choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen"
